sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ansar-blocks directory, or install via the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Start using the masonry templates in the block editor.
sections.faq:
What is the plugin license?

  • This plugin is released under a GPL license.

What themes this plugin supports?

  • The plugin supports all Popular themes.
